nodes.name: VIN_5V
nodes.semantic_role: External 5V input rail for analog stage supply and 3.3V regulation source

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 generates the internal VCC_3V3 rail from external VIN_5V. This module is the sole provider of 3.3V power for the MCU and DAC. Common GND is shared with the analog stage. The regulator output must feed all 3.3V consumers through this module; VIN_5V is used directly by the NE5532 analog stage and is not redistributed here as a virtual port because it is a global external rail.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P provides digital control for the preamplifier by acting as the I2C bus master to the MCP4725 DAC. This module consumes VCC_3V3 and shares common GND. Use the MCU I2C-capable PC4/PC5 pins for SDA/SCL bus ownership. AVCC must be powered from the same 3.3V rail as VCC; AREF is present on the device and should be left in a valid biasing/reference state during detailed implementation. This module is the intended owner of shared I2C master routing intent and associated bus biasing policy.

nodes.name: dac_control
nodes.description: MCP4725 is a single-channel 12-bit I2C DAC powered from VCC_3V3. It is an I2C slave on the shared control bus and produces an analog control/bias voltage at VOUT. The DAC VOUT is routed into the NE5532 channel-1 non-inverting input network through a later passive conditioning/bias network; this preserves the brief requirement that DAC output provides the bias/control voltage for the amplifier input network. The A0 pin exists and must be tied to a defined logic level during detailed implementation to select the intended I2C address. This module does not own I2C pull-ups.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: audio_preamp
nodes.description: NE5532 implements the analog preamplifier stage on VIN_5V with common GND. Channel 1 is used as the single-channel audio preamplifier in non-inverting amplifier topology: an external audio input is applied to the non-inverting signal path, and the DAC-derived control voltage is injected into that same non-inverting input network through a passive bias/control network added later. Channel-1 feedback network components are external to this phase but must realize stable non-inverting gain. Because only a single preamp channel is requested, channel 2 is unused; its IN2_P and IN2_N must be tied to a safe bias state during detailed implementation, and OUT2 remains unused. The brief requires VIN_5V to power the analog stage directly; no separate generated analog rail is planned. Note that the provided single 5V supply and common ground imply single-supply operation constraints for the audio signal swing and biasing network, which must be handled in downstream design.
